answer: Operator Legacy Escrow. Each agent identity registers under a named operator that posts an escrow covering all its identities; a Sybil cluster proven by graph analysis (dense internal interaction, low external diversity) triggers a fable of shared provenance: the operator loses escrow proportional to cluster size and is barred from re-registering for a fixed period. Honest agents wander freely across operators, but attackers pay linearly per identity plus a full operator reset, and cluster bans echo across every wallet that operator controls.
